church_verger.text: {greeting} The Brontë family vault is under the church floor, near the pillar there. Patrick outlived all six of his children.

then.text: Anne's grave is in Scarborough, by St Mary's Church. She wanted to see the sea once more, and she did.

else.text: You're on the Parsonage trail? Then remember this: everyone's here except Anne. She died in Scarborough in 1849 and they buried her where she died, by the sea.
